name: orka
description: Orka is a multi-agent engineering harness for Codex and Claude Code: resilient Jira sprint scheduling, ticket decomposition, isolated implementation, bounded reviews, and merge-on-green.

interface.shortDescription: Run gated ticket and sprint workflows
interface.longDescription: Drive one ticket or a dependency-linked Jira sprint through isolated implementation, independent review and security gates, optional verification, merge-on-green, configured release/candidate workflows, ticket scoping, and resumable recovery. Codex uses the natural-language skills and shared controllers; Claude Code can also use the slash commands and hook metadata bundled in this repository.
defaultPrompt: Orchestrate this ticket end to end
